Llm._comment: Do NOT put the real key here - this file is committed to git and providers auto-revoke leaked keys. Put it in appsettings.Development.json (gitignored) or the GROQ_API_KEY env var.

Query._DeniedCollectionsComment: Empty = every collection is answerable. Add names here to hide them from the LLM entirely, e.g. [ "otpCodes", "users" ].

Seed._comment: Inserts demo customers/orders. Keep false against a real database.
